evidenceType: Flutter unit/widget tests with mocked HTTP and secure storage plus temporary file tests; no provider, live backend, physical device, APK/IPA build or store validation.
limitations: Paid-intent metadata storage and HTTP responses are fixtures; actual platform secure storage and network/server receipts require a separate device/integration run.
Lost output is not replayed or recovered; completed/conflict receipts preserve the request key.
Seven-day old uncertainty is blocked instead of silently issuing a new paid operation. Explicit reset core API is not yet exposed as a full native receipt-management screen.
Mobile source version remains0.4.0+4; no rebuilt binary is claimed.
